title: Monica Contact Interaction Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monica:contact interaction_count=*
| stats sum(interaction_count) as total_value, avg(interaction_count) as avg_value by relationship_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks relationship type values by total and average interaction count across Monica contact events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `interaction_count` values for each Monica contact event and review total and average interaction count by relationship type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total interaction count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which relationship type shows the biggest interaction count numbers in your Monica contact data.
